name: Walking Voices
description: A crowd of singers that is always the same people: change the chord and everyone walks to the nearest new note, so the voice leading is heard inside the sound.

params.name: People
params.description: How many people are in the crowd, shared out over the held notes. Every note keeps two of them; when there are too few, the second stands in the first one's shadow.

params.name: Body
params.description: What everyone sounds with: an open mouth, a closed one, a hollow pipe, whistling, a reed or a bowed string. A crowd changes over one after another.

params.name: Path
params.description: How people get to a note: glide there, walk up in spoken steps, turn around it in waves, leap onto it at once, or hold back and settle after the others.

params.name: Lag
params.description: How long people take to notice a new chord and walk to it, each in a time of their own. Two on each note answer soon; long lets the others follow one by one.

params.name: Reach
params.description: How far off a note people may start when they come in from silence or from a breath, and how wide a turn is. At zero they come in on the note.

params.name: Stubbornness
params.description: How long the slow ones stay on the old note when the harmony moves. High up some of them hold out for seconds and a few never give in.

params.name: Agreement
params.description: How far people agree on tuning and vowel. Low is a quarrel of pitches, the middle a warm crowd, and at the top they lock onto pure intervals over the lowest note.

params.name: Wander
params.description: How often someone leaves for another held note or an octave and comes back later. Nobody goes who would leave a note with fewer than two.

params.name: Leader
params.description: How far one person on each note stands out in front of the crowd. Leaders move first and stand in the middle; all the way up they sing nearly alone.

params.name: Low share
params.description: Where the crowd gathers. Turned up, the low notes are sung by more and louder, some an octave under the lowest; turned down it is the top and the octave over it.

params.name: Vowel
params.description: The shape of the mouth, from closed and dark through open to bright. On the other bodies it moves the size and the pull of what they sound with.

params.name: Vowel spread
params.description: How differently people shape the sound, and how much each one's shape moves by itself. At zero the whole crowd sings one vowel.

params.name: Breath length
params.description: How long each person sings before taking a breath and coming in again. Short turns a chord into murmured syllables, long into a wall with no seams.

params.name: Fade
params.description: How far each person sinks in the course of a breath. At zero they hold it full; all the way up every note dies away in one breath, like something struck.

params.name: Effort
params.description: How hard people sing. Low is dark and close, high is bright and strong. A harder touch on the keys adds to it.

params.name: Strain
params.description: How tense people get when they come in and while they are off their note: brighter, harder and rougher, easing once they have settled.

params.name: Air
params.description: How much breath is in the sound. It has the shape of the mouth and the beat of the note; all the way up the plain tone is gone and a whisper is left.

params.name: Vibrato
params.description: How far each person's pitch swings once the note has been found, each at a pace of their own. The voice opens and brightens a little with it.

params.name: Attack
params.description: How long a person takes to come up to full voice on a new note. Leaping and stepping people are quicker about it, and those who come late are slower.

params.name: Release
params.description: How long the crowd takes to die away after the last key. Leaps and pipes let go sooner, turns and strings later. With keys still held, people walk over instead.

params.name: Room spread
params.description: How far apart people stand in the room. At zero they share one spot in front; higher spreads them wide and deep, with the walls answering the ones at the back.

params.name: Volume
params.description: Overall output level of the instrument.

origin.note: Written for live-mix on cpp/kit. A fixed pool of 36 singers is dealt out to the held notes by least total motion; each singer is a set of grains in step with the pitch, of one of six kinds. Levels and tables are voiced by measurement, not taken from a recording.
